question: In the context of banking, which of the following does the letter 'M' stand for in MICR?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Magnetic**__.

__
 
• **MICR code in the banking stands for Magnetic Ink Character Recognition.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

 
• **MICR (Magnetic Ink Character Recognition)** code is a code printed on cheques.
 
• The embedded code is printed in MICR.
 
• It enables the identification of the **cheques**, which results in faster processing.
 
• A **MICR code **is a** 9-digit code.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4435e9bff617e44affe992808326f055b6e47c05b8cbb1704cd5b9b79f6907be.png] 

 
• It identifies the bank and branch participating in an Electronic Clearing System (ECS).
 
• **It comprises 3 parts:**
 
 
• The first three digits represent the city i.e. **City Code.**
 
• The next 3 digits represent the bank i.e. **Bank Code.**
 
• The last 3 digits represent the branch i.e. **Branch Code**.​
